name: Ströer SE & Co. KGaA
summary: Ströer SE & Co. KGaA provides out-of-home (OOH) media and digital out-of-home advertising services in Germany and internationally. The company operates through three segments: OOH Media, Digital & Dialog Media, and DaaS & E-Commerce. It offers traditional analog OOH advertising products, including traditional poster media to advertisements at bus and tram shelters, and on public transport.
